name: allsight-local-ai-translator
description: Private Chrome MV3 web page translator for Chrome AI or an OpenAI-compatible Local LLM.

scripts.check: node --check src/background.js && node --check src/content-core.js && node --check src/content.js && node --check src/settings.js && node --check src/local-llm.js && node --check src/options.js && node --check tests/content-core.test.js && node --check tests/local-llm.test.js && node --check tests/manifest-assets.test.js && node --check tests/settings.test.js
scripts.package:store: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist | Out-Null; Compress-Archive -Path manifest.json,src,assets -DestinationPath dist/allsight-local-ai-translator-0.1.0.zip -Force"
